watertight.method: every edge shared by exactly 2 faces (trimesh)

manifold3d_valid.method: manifold3d.Manifold accepts mesh as 2-manifold; volume agrees with trimesh

self_intersections.method: rtree AABB candidate pairs (no shared vertex) + segment/triangle tests
self_intersections.note: best effort: vertex-sharing pairs and coplanar overlaps are not tested

voxel_volume_agreement.method: parity re-voxelisation volume vs mesh volume

min_thickness.method: solid volume not covered by inscribed balls of diameter ~1.0461 mm (minus 1 voxel tolerance) on a 0.15 mm re-voxelisation; pass if < 1%
min_thickness.note: approximate (voxel resolution); ray thickness is informational only

enclosed_cavities.method: single watertight shell => no internal cavity (exact); voxel void labelling (approx.)
enclosed_cavities.note: a cavity smaller than the voxel pitch could be missed by the voxel check, but not by the topological argument

dimensions.method: bounding box extents vs (80.0, 80.0, 12.0) mm (+-1 mm)
